unit: WF4 Approval Gate yields DRY_RUN after all checks pass when Config dry_run is the string true
description: A fully valid APPROVE whose Config dry_run is the string "true" must pass every check and then return gate DRY_RUN, never SEND, carrying the normalised boolean dry_run and the full delivery identity.
why_it_exists: AGENTS.md section 5 records that dry_run is hardcoded to the STRING "true" in WF4's Config and that much of the observed safety comes from that one literal. The delivery-key families and the decision families never asserted that a passing dry run resolves to gate DRY_RUN rather than SEND. This pins the DRY_RUN terminal, that the string literal normalises to the boolean true, and that Config keys pass through unchanged.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.gate_reason_contains: DRY_RUN is on in the Config node
expect.note: The string dry_run "true" passes the normalisation check, every gate check passes, and the terminal is DRY_RUN — nothing is written and nothing leaves the account.

assertions: a fully valid APPROVE with Config dry_run "true" returns gate DRY_RUN, not SEND
the string literal dry_run is normalised to the boolean true on the output
the full delivery identity is present for the dry-run report
Config keys the downstream nodes read (matter_id, approval_id, route_group) pass through unchanged
all idempotency checks pass (no prior Communications row) so the only reason the gate stops short of SEND is dry_run
